baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cognate pair at words 2 and 4 makes the sky at word 3 the explicit bearer of intensive motion, while word 1 frames the occurrence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The normally overhead cover loses inertness and surges back and forth; the verb-plus-cognate-accusative construction presents motion as the event's defining operation rather than a passing tremor.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day turns the temporal noun into an occurrence defined by what befalls.
Back-and-forth surging supplies the sky's intensive oscillatory motion.
The overhead cover supplies the normally stable surface that is made to surge.

changed_reading.before: A day on which the sky generally moves.
changed_reading.after: A severe occurrence constituted by the overhead frame entering total, repeated surge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 2 and 4 can image wavering flow or pouring, with the overhead sky at word 3 as the flowing medium.
baseline_models.mechanism: Rather than a solid vault merely rocking, the upper expanse behaves like a mobile medium that runs, pours, and folds through itself.

activation_trace.role: Wavering flow and pouring convert motion into material transport through the upper expanse.
The sky as upper cover locates that flow overhead rather than in an ordinary terrestrial liquid.

changed_reading.before: The sky shakes as a bounded object.
changed_reading.after: The sky's own medium runs and pours in unstable waves.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same motion root at words 2 and 4 carries a shedding branch, applied grammatically to the overhead cover at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sky's movement can be carried as sloughing: an upper body or covering loses an outer layer as motion becomes material separation.

activation_trace.role: Seasonal coat-shedding supplies loss of an outer layer as a form of mūr.
The upper covering supplies the layer capable of loosening and coming away.

changed_reading.before: Motion leaves the sky materially intact.
changed_reading.after: The overhead layer moves by shedding or sloughing portions of itself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping of the sky root at word 3 activates visible marks and marks read as signs, while words 2 and 4 put that sign-bearing surface in motion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sky is carried not only as matter but as an identifying and inferential surface; its mūr makes the field of visible signs unstable and newly conspicuous.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark supplies the sky with a sign-bearing surface.
A sign read by observation makes that marked surface evidentiary rather than merely decorative.
Oscillation makes the visible evidence itself move and resist a static reading.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports only a physical disturbance.
changed_reading.after: The physical disturbance is also a moving field of signs that demands interpretation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The non-dominant mapping of the sky root at word 3 supplies penetrating hot wind, while the motion root supplies wavering flow.
baseline_models.mechanism: The upper disturbance can be carried as an invasive current: what was distant overhead becomes a moving medium capable of crossing boundaries and entering the lived environment.

activation_trace.role: Penetrating hot wind supplies an invasive atmospheric quality through the split sky mapping.
Wavering flow gives that penetrating medium a spreading, pouring motion.

changed_reading.before: The sky's motion remains remote and visual.
changed_reading.after: The moving sky is provisionally felt as a penetrating current that can reach inward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opened written sheet at the beginning, the later pairing of created heavens with absent certainty, the question about writing the unseen, and the sight of a falling sky-fragment together revise the marked-sky baseline into an epistemic event: the visible register moves, yet observers can still overwrite its indication.

activation_trace.role: The focus sky's observable mark supplies the evidentiary surface being revised.
Oscillation makes the sign-field dynamically visible rather than fixed.
Ordered letters and the written object supply a textual register for comparison with the sky.
A written aligned row gives that register visible organization.
Written parchment supplies a thin material surface that bears the ordered marks.
Opening and spreading makes the marked surface exposed for inspection.
The context heaven repeats the sign-read-by-observation branch beside a challenge about certainty.
Settled knowledge versus doubt supplies the epistemic consequence of reading the visible field.
What is hidden from sight supplies the contrast to an exposed moving sign.
Writing the hidden returns the textual-register motif as a challenged claim to knowledge.
Direct visual perception supplies the final test in which the moving sign is seen but reclassified.

structural_cues: 52:2-3 opens a written sheet before the focus scene; 52:36 and 52:41 explicitly connect heaven, certainty, the hidden, and writing.
In 52:44 the see-then-say construction separates available visual evidence from the observers' chosen account of it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies marked-sign branches, an opened text, certainty language, hidden writing, and seeing; I infer one epistemic chain in which cosmic motion functions as evidence, while the live alternative is that these are separate rhetorical motifs.

changed_reading.before: A marked sky merely undergoes physical oscillation.
changed_reading.after: The sky becomes a moving public register whose evidence is exposed yet still liable to interpretive erasure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The raised roof before the focus and the hard elevated mountains displaced after it couple upper and lower landmarks. Mūr therefore reads as loss of the whole reference frame, not weather moving against a stable world.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies the upper reference surface.
Surging oscillation removes stability from that upper surface.
The high roof gives the upper surface an architectural, load-bearing image.
Physical raising establishes the roof in its prior elevated station.
Displacement and removal turn motion into loss of station rather than harmless travel.
A hard elevated mass supplies the normally fixed lower landmark that is also displaced.

structural_cues: The focus is bracketed by a raised upper structure in 52:5 and mountains moving with their own cognate accusative in 52:10.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a raised roof, a surging sky, and displaced hard elevations; I infer coupled frame failure, while they could alternatively be independent signs listed in sequence.

changed_reading.before: The sky moves while the observer's world remains a stable frame.
changed_reading.after: Upper cover and lower anchors both lose station, so orientation itself has no fixed reference.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wide sea, its filling or kindling, and an irresistible flood-wave image activate the focus branch of wavering flow. The upper cover can now be read as a pressurized sky-sea whose contents surge, pour, or change phase.

activation_trace.role: Wavering flow and pouring provide the focus mechanism of mobile material.
The upper cover relocates that mobile material above the observer.
Abundant broad water supplies the sea-scale volume for the fluid analogy.
Filling with water supplies pressure and saturation within that volume.
Kindling fire adds a live phase-changing alternative to simple liquid filling.
A flood or wave whose masses drive one another makes the ensuing motion dynamically irresistible.

structural_cues: The sea immediately precedes the guaranteed, unrepellable event; the focus then names wavering motion before mountains are displaced.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies broad water, filling or kindling, an unrepellable wave, and focus pouring; I infer pressure or phase transfer into the upper expanse, while filling and kindling may remain disjunct lexical alternatives.

changed_reading.before: The canopy rocks without transporting substance.
changed_reading.after: The overhead expanse behaves like an overfilled or kindled sea, surging and pouring beyond containment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later punishment phrase independently realizes the same mapped branch as penetrating hot wind. It feeds back into the split focus mapping so that the sky's wavering flow can be felt as thermal invasion rather than distant spectacle.

activation_trace.role: The split sky mapping supplies penetrating hot wind as the latent atmospheric quality.
Wavering flow gives that hot medium directional spread.
Painful punishment supplies the harmful consequence attached to the current.
Penetrating hot wind is independently named in context and directly reactivates the focus's non-dominant mapped branch.

structural_cues: The packet maps focus س م و to root_000743 non-dominantly, then presents surface س م م with that same inventory in 52:27.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact mapped-branch recurrence and a punishment phrase; I infer continuity between upper motion and invasive heat, while the live alternative is that the split mapping should not color ordinary السماء semantically.

changed_reading.before: The sky's mūr is remote visual instability.
changed_reading.after: The instability becomes a penetrating hot flow that crosses from the overhead field into embodied exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene supplies a detached piece from the sky, downward fall, cloud-drag, and piled mass. These cues turn the focus's remote coat-shedding branch into a coherent delamination model: the cover loosens, separates, and descends in accumulated layers.

activation_trace.role: Shedding an outer coat supplies the focus's latent material-separation mechanism.
The overhead cover supplies the layer that can delaminate.
Direct sight makes the separated material perceptible rather than purely inferred.
A detached piece of a body or sky supplies the separated unit.
The repeated overhead-sky branch identifies the layer's source.
Downward casting supplies the separated layer's trajectory.
A drawn-along cloud supplies an observer's materially plausible misclassification.
Piling one portion above another supplies accumulated lamination rather than a single shard.

structural_cues: 52:44's sequence is visual perception, a piece sourced from the sky, downward motion, then verbal relabeling as piled cloud.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shedding, detachment, falling, dragging, and piling; I infer one delamination process, while the alternative is that 52:9 names turbulence and 52:44 a distinct later fall.

changed_reading.before: Shedding is only a branch-distant analogy for motion.
changed_reading.after: The sky's mūr plausibly includes layers loosening into visible, falling, piled masses.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated event-day language, the encounter with one's day, an appointed time, and the recession of the stars make the focus temporal noun active. Mūr can coexist as phase-turnover: the cosmic cycle reaches a boundary that must be met rather than merely dating a physical shake.

activation_trace.role: A severe occasion lets the focus day denote the event itself.
Circling back from a descent supplies a turning or return-shaped motion at the event boundary.
Their event-day personalizes the severe occasion as something awaiting encounter.
What a person meets of good or harm turns the day from a date into an arriving confrontation.
The proper time of an act supplies an articulated temporal threshold.
The last part and passing consequence supply closure of a celestial phase.
The rising star supplies the regular celestial marker whose recession closes the sequence.

structural_cues: The focus begins with يوم; 52:45-46 repeat يوم near the end, and 52:49 closes with the retreat of stellar markers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies event-days, encounter, appointed time, and stellar recession; I infer temporal phase-turnover as a second axis of mūr, while the alternative is that these cues only schedule separate physical events.

changed_reading.before: Day is a passive timestamp for sky-motion.
changed_reading.after: The day is the met phase-boundary itself, with sky-motion rendering the cosmic order's turnover.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins the road branch of mūr to a later ladder and act of listening, rather than to ordinary sky-motion. It remains anchored in the focus's exact motion root and overhead cover, but downstream prose should render it only as an as-if traversed celestial corridor, not as a lexical replacement for sky.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The road made by repeated passage is a branch of words 2 and 4, and the sky at word 3 supplies the overhead domain through which such passage is imagined.

activation_trace.role: A path constituted by repeated movement supplies a traffic-based reading of mūr.
The overhead sky locates the path in the celestial cover.
A ladder as steps and means supplies vertical access to the overhead route.
Hearing through that access supplies the traffic's communicative purpose.

changed_reading.before: The sky is a substance that oscillates in place.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the celestial expanse behaves like a repeatedly traversed corridor whose passage becomes visible as mūr.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it activates the cutting-sword sense of mūr and a cutting-line branch from the earlier inscription. It remains anchored to the focus motion and the later cut-off sky piece; downstream prose should qualify it as a possible shearing-front image, not assert that the verb literally means cutting here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 2 and 4 carry a branch in which a cutting blade moves through a blow, with the sky at word 3 as the affected cover.

activation_trace.role: A cutting sword moving through the stroke supplies a directional shearing front within mūr.
The overhead covering supplies the material field through which the front travels.
A line of striking and cutting supplies an earlier linear propagation image.
Cutting a piece from a whole supplies the shearing front's material result.
Downward fall supplies the trajectory of the severed portion.

changed_reading.before: Mūr is nondirectional wavering of an intact cover.
changed_reading.after: As a contained outlier, mūr can image a cut propagating through the cover and releasing a falling segment.

strongest_changes: The raised roof and displaced hard mountains revise local sky-turbulence into loss of the whole spatial reference frame.
The sea and unrepellable-wave sequence activates a pressurized fluid sky, while the later falling fragment strengthens material delamination.
Writing, certainty, hidden knowledge, and misclassified sight activate a moving sign-surface alongside the physical readings.
Repeated event-day and end-of-stars cues make temporal phase-turnover coexist with oscillation, flow, and shedding.
The exact recurrence of the non-dominant hot-wind mapping preserves an invasive thermal reading rather than filtering it out.
summary.what_was_special: The verb-plus-cognate-accusative makes motion unusually concentrated, while the sky root's split inventories allow the same short clause to activate cover, visible sign, and penetrating medium. Later context independently realizes several remote branches, especially detached sky-material and hot wind.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the non-dominant mark and hot-wind mappings should color the semantic reading or remain only formal latent activations.
Whether the falling fragment in 52:44 is the same process as the focus mūr or a distinct consequence.
Whether the sea cue foregrounds filling, emptying, ignition, or deliberately keeps those material states live together.
The ladder-route and traversing-cut readings remain intentionally contained because their focus branches are exact but form-distant.
